description: Land Acquisition - Chemmalai, Maritimepattu D/S Division, Mullaitivu District - Amendment  to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1645/12 of 16.03.2010 by Wattala D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act.
